# temps_node_build_limits (Resource)

How many builds a node runs at once and how long they may queue and run. Temps has no endpoint to read the limits back, so changes made elsewhere are not detected and destroying only stops managing them.

Import with `<node_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_node_build_limits" "builder" {
  node_id               = 2
  concurrency           = 2
  queue_wait_seconds    = 600
  build_timeout_seconds = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_timeout_seconds` (Number) Longest a build may run.
- `concurrency` (Number) Builds running at once.
- `node_id` (Number) ID of a worker node. The control plane (`0`) has no per-node build limits.
- `queue_wait_seconds` (Number) Longest a build waits for a slot.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<node_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <node_id>
terraform import temps_node_build_limits.builder 2
```
